title: Asymptotic Bound for Condorcet Winner Probability
statement: Let $(f_n)_{n\ge 0}$ be a sequence of sign-valued functions on the corresponding sign cubes, and suppose that for every $n$, all singleton Fourier coefficients of the real-valued version of $f_n$ are equal. For every $\varepsilon>0$, for all sufficiently large $n$, the probability that a uniformly random ranking profile of $n$ voters produces a societal Condorcet winner is at most $\frac79+\frac{4}{9\pi}+\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence $f_n$ of sign-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cubes
